_readme: Field Notes: short posts on the homepage (index.html#notes). While posts is empty the section and its nav link stay hidden: never add sample posts or placeholder dates.
Add one object per post, newest first. Fields: title, lane, date (YYYY-MM-DD, the day it was published), url (https; the LinkedIn post or wherever it lives), summary (one or two sentences, optional).

lane must be one of: build-in-public (demos, workflows, prototypes, AI experiments, lessons learned), strategists-perspective (culture, technology, the creative industry, media, the future of work), behind-the-work (photography, video, editing, podcasting, life as an independent creative).
